---
title: "About"
---

This website is the capstone project of **Cohort 10 of the [Climatebase Fellowship](https://climatebase.org/)**.

Publicly available data is not the same as usable data. US climate and Earth observation data is spread
across agencies, each with its own website, format and access method. Sources differ in resolution and
update frequency, and some are at risk of being discontinued.

We research and showcase how these datasets can be found, accessed, combined and used in practice,
through three use cases: **agriculture**, **droughts** and **El Niño**.

## Disclaimer

- This project is for **educational and research purposes only**. It is not a commercial product.
- It is **not affiliated with or endorsed by** Climatebase, NASA, USDA, NOAA or any other data provider.
- **All data belongs to its respective owners** and is used under their licenses and terms of use.
  See the data sources listed with each map.
- The maps and analyses are provided **as is, without any warranty** of accuracy, completeness or timeliness.
  They must not be used for agricultural, financial, insurance or emergency decisions.
  Please refer to the official sources for that.
- Views expressed in blog posts are those of the authors.

Data owners with concerns about how their data is used can contact us via the
[project repository](https://github.com/ostojanovic/capstone-cohort10/issues).
